x-note: Integration-test environment (FND-010): PostgreSQL, an S3-compatible store and the export worker image. JSON is valid YAML, so `podman compose -f infra/containers/compose.json --env-file infra/containers/.env.example ...` reads this file, and infra/test-env.ps1 starts the same definitions with `podman run` (Compose cannot disable cgroups, which the WSL Podman machine needs). Everything uses host networking and binds 127.0.0.1 only; data lives on tmpfs, so every start is clean. Credentials come from .env.example and are test values. PostgreSQL, the store and the sandbox settings extend infra/containers/compose.base.json, which the reference host's demo stack extends too (FND-010 criterion 2).
name: docedit-test

postgres.x-note: PostgreSQL, as compose.base.json defines it, with its data on tmpfs.

s3.x-note: The S3-compatible store, as compose.base.json defines it, with its data on tmpfs.

export-worker.x-note: The sandboxed compile worker of 09 §9.3, built from services/export-worker/Containerfile (owned by the export work; referenced, not copied). One container per job: a tar of the bundle on standard input, a tar of the outputs on standard output, no network. Memory, CPU and process limits are set per job by services/export-worker/src/sandbox.ts.
